text:
Predicates:
PerformsInSchoolTalentShow(x) ::: x performs in school talent shows often.
AttendsSchoolEvents(x) ::: x attends and is very engaged with school events.
CommunityMember(x) ::: x is a member of the community.
InactiveMember(x) ::: x is an inactive and disinterested member of the community.
ChaperonesHighSchoolDance(x) ::: x chaperones high school dances.
AttendsSchool(x) ::: x attends the school.
YoungChildOrTeen(x) ::: x is a young child or teenager.
WishesToFurtherAcademic(x) ::: x wishes to further their academic careers and educational opportunities.
Student(x) ::: x is a student who attends the school.
Bonnie ::: Bonnie (constant).
Premises:
∀x (PerformsInSchoolTalentShow(x) → AttendsSchoolEvents(x)) ::: If people perform in school talent shows often, then they attend and are very engaged with school events.
∀x (PerformsInSchoolTalentShow(x) ∨ InactiveMember(x)) ::: People either perform in school talent shows often or are inactive and disinterested members of their community.
∀x (ChaperonesHighSchoolDance(x) → ¬AttendsSchool(x)) ::: If people chaperone high school dances, then they are not students who attend the school.
∀x (InactiveMember(x) → ChaperonesHighSchoolDance(x)) ::: All inactive and disinterested members of the community chaperone high school dances.
∀x (YoungChildOrTeen(x) ∧ WishesToFurtherAcademic(x)) → Student(x) ::: All young children and teenagers who wish to further their academic careers and educational opportunities are students who attend the school.
Bonnie is either both attending and very engaged, and a student, or neither attending and very engaged nor a student.
( (AttendsSchoolBonnie ∧ EngagedBonnie ∧ StudentBonnie) ∨ (¬AttendsSchoolBonnie ∧ ¬EngagedBonnie ∧ ¬StudentBonnie) ) ::: For Bonnie.
Conclusion:
( (WishesToFurtherAcademicBonnie ∧ ChaperonesHighSchoolDanceBonnie) ∨ (¬WishesToFurtherAcademicBonnie ∧ ¬ChaperonesHighSchoolDanceBonnie) ) → ( StudentBonnie ∨ InactiveMemberBonnie ) ::: If Bonnie is either both a young child or teenager who wishes to further her academic career and educational opportunities and chaperones high school dances or neither is a young child nor teenager who wishes to further her academic career and educational opportunities, then Bonnie is either a student who attends the school or is an inactive and disinterested member of the community.
